messages.text: Happy to help with that. What's your order number, and either the name on the order or the postcode?

Thanks Nathan, got it. Your Bitfortun BS-2 shipped September 12 and was delivered October 5, so there's nothing left to cancel on it.

What's going on with it? If the unit is faulty or dead on arrival I can start you on the RMA, and if it's something else, tell me and I'll sort out the right route.

Sorry about that. What's it doing, no power at all, or does it boot but not hash?

One thing I have to ask up front: has it been overclocked or modified? Overclocked units aren't covered.

If it's dead out of the box, the RMA form is the intake and they send you a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

For a faster hands-on fix, our Discord is the quickest route, post there and mention @nullhashrate (JD): https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
Handed to the team · Delivered faulty unit, RMA already filed, customer wants money back - refund is

Good, that's the right step. Once your RMA form is in, you get a return label, and the unit is processed within 10 days of reaching the warehouse.

I've pinged Abel and Georges on this one so it doesn't sit. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here; if you step away, you'll get the answer by email.

Meanwhile, what does it actually do when you plug it in, any lights or fans?
Before you go, one thing: what made you go straight for a refund rather than a replacement unit?

Understood, a refund it is. That's already with Abel and Georges along with your RMA, so you don't need to do anything else.

Stay in the chat and one of them will pick it up here. If you step away, the answer comes to your email.

Perfect. They're on now, so it shouldn't be long.

While you wait, if you can tell me what the unit does when you power it up, lights, fans, anything on the dashboard, I'll add it to the notes so they have the full picture.

Totally dead is usually the power supply, not the miner itself. We ship replacement PSUs on their own, no need to return the whole unit.

Quick check: try a different outlet and, if you have one, a different cable. Any light on the PSU brick itself?

I've noted "no lights, no fans, dead on power up" for the team.

Noted on your order, Nathan, so whoever picks it up sees the fault straight away.

Anything else I can look at while you wait?

All good. Abel or Georges will come in here on the refund, and you'll get the whole conversation by email once we're done, so you'll have it in writing.

If you want a second pair of eyes on the dead unit meanwhile, our Discord is quick: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post there and mention @nullhashrate.

Yes, you can step away. The answer on the refund comes to your email at (email hidden), and a copy of this whole conversation lands there too once we close.

The team is offline right now and picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET. Worth checking your spam folder, since everything on this order goes to that address.
Closing it now, Nathan. Your refund request and the dead-unit details are with the team, and they'll email you from 10am ET tomorrow. Sorry again the BS-2 turned up dead.
